tagline: IT Director at mid-market manufacturing firm managing legacy infrastructure
description: David oversees a lean team and is primarily concerned with preventing downtime and securing aging hardware against modern threats.
rationale: David represents the primary decision-maker in the 'high-risk, low-bandwidth' segment identified in recent support tickets regarding legacy compatibility.
His purchase trigger is usually a near-miss security event or an insurance audit, making him a high-intent lead for automated protection modules.
Strategically valuable because this segment has a high retention rate once the initial integration hurdle is cleared.
